scripts.dev: npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:backend
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.docker:test: docker-compose build && docker-compose up -d && sleep 5 && npm run docker:health
scripts.docker:health: curl -f http://localhost:3000/ && curl -f http://localhost:80/ && echo '✅ All services healthy' || (echo '❌ Health check failed' && exit 1)
